title: Registered email address: user receives a reset link by email
expected: A confirmation message is shown and the user receives a reset link by email

title: Email address without an @ sign is rejected
steps: Enter "userexample.com" in the email address field
expected: The email address is rejected, a validation error is shown next to the field, and this does not happen: the user receives a reset link by email

title: Empty email address is rejected
steps: Leave the email address field empty
expected: The form is not submitted, a required-field message is shown for the email address, and this does not happen: the user receives a reset link by email

title: New password with 7 characters is rejected
steps: Enter "Passw0r" (7 characters) in the new password field
expected: The new password is rejected, the form is not submitted and an error message explains the limit (at least 8 characters)

title: New password with 8 characters is accepted
steps: Enter "Passw0rd" (8 characters) in the new password field
expected: The new password is accepted because 8 characters is within the limit (at least 8 characters), the form is submitted and a success message is shown

title: New password with 9 characters is accepted
steps: Enter "Passw0rd!" (9 characters) in the new password field
expected: The new password is accepted because 9 characters is within the limit (at least 8 characters), the form is submitted and a success message is shown
